spans.s: A kind of grass (said to have turned to clubs when plucked by Kṛṣṇa and his family; cf. [[Mb.]] मौसलपर्वन्), ददार करजैर्वक्षस्येरकां कटकृद्यथा [[

The castor-oil plant; (a small tree with a scanty number of leaves); and hence the proverb: निरस्तपादपे देशे एरण्डोऽपि द्रुमायते. 
-ण्डा Long pepper. 
-Comp. 
-पत्रिका, -फला the plant Croton Polyandrum (दन्तीवृक्ष).
